title: Continuous-depth Deep Gaussian Processes
abstract: arXiv:2610.30890v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep Gaussian processes (DGPs) are appealing Bayesian regression models, but their standard discrete-depth parameterization often becomes harder to optimize as depth grows. We argue that depth is better treated as a latent continuous evolution than as a long discrete stack. We therefore propose a continuous-depth formulation in which the latent representation follows a stochastic differential equation with a depth-indexed drift family equipped with a GP-based prior. This reframes the core design choice as the prior placed on that family, rather than adopting a purely neural continuous-depth parameterization as in neural ODE or neural SDE models. We study two instantiations of this idea: CDGP, a direct GP prior over the state--depth drift, and FlowDGP, a flow-evolved prior that captures richer depth dependence at lower training cost. translated_title: 连续深度的深度高斯过程
translated_abstract: 深度高斯过程（DGPs）是一类很有吸引力的贝叶斯回归模型，但其标准的离散深度参数化往往随深度增加而变得更难优化。我们认为，与其将深度视为一长串离散堆叠，不如将其视为一种潜在的连续演化。为此，我们提出了一种连续深度的建模形式：隐表示遵循一个随机微分方程，其漂移项是按深度索引的函数族，并在该函数族上配备基于高斯过程的先验。这将核心设计选择重新聚焦于施加在该函数族上的先验，而不是像神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）或神经随机微分方程（Neural SDE）模型那样采用纯神经网络的连续深度参数化。我们研究了这一思想的两种具体实现：CDGP，对状态-深度漂移直接施加高斯过程先验；以及 FlowDGP，一种通过流演化得到的先验，能以更低的训练成本捕捉更丰富的深度依赖关系。为论证这一重新设计的必要性，我们分析了单样本 DGP 目标如何会变得愈发敏感……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出将深度高斯过程的深度视为由随机微分方程刻画的连续演化，并在深度索引的漂移函数族上施加高斯过程先验（CDGP 与 FlowDGP 两种实现），从而缓解传统离散深度 DGP 随深度增长而难以优化的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes treating the depth of deep Gaussian processes as a continuous evolution governed by a stochastic differential equation with GP-based priors on the depth-indexed drift family (instantiated as CDGP and FlowDGP), alleviating the optimization difficulties of deep discrete-depth DGPs.
